central_value: EGamma data application region after prompt-photon and electron contamination subtraction, weighted by data-measured fake factors

closure.central_value_policy: QCD closure does not rescale the data-driven central value; the larger of 30%, observed nonclosure, and closure statistical uncertainty is assigned, capped at 100%

data_deduplication.policy: deduplicate by run-lumi-event; prefer NANOv15_v2, then the highest processing version, then EGamma0; retain every probe category from the chosen source

mc_roles.qcd: prompt/electron origins participate in contamination subtraction and are retained in the target; the truth-fake origin is used for closure and nonclosure uncertainty

method: sieie anti-ID measurement region fake factor applied to the charged-isolation-fail application region
nominal_intermediate_policy: read-only; fake sidebands are extracted directly from NanoAOD into a separate campaign and no nominal intermediate is modified

target_validation.blinding_policy: the target-region residual is reported only as validation and is not used to normalize or fit the fake prediction
